description: Use this when the user asks how serious a CVE is, such as "how bad is CVE-2021-44228?", or about an advisory id that triage_dependencies names, such as GHSA-wrw7-89jp-8q8g or RUSTSEC-2024-0370. Pass the CVE id, or a GHSA, RUSTSEC, GO or PYSEC advisory id. A CVE that NVD has not published yet, and an advisory with no CVE, are answered from OSV.dev with an osv block. Returns a priority (exploited, likely, routine or unknown), the description, CVSS score and severity, whether the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog lists it, the EPSS exploitation probability, a patch or advisory link when tagged, and the as_of dates. A lookup by CVE id: it does not know which software the user runs or whether they are affected.

cve.description: A CVE id such as "CVE-2021-44228", or an OSV.dev advisory id such as "GHSA-wrw7-89jp-8q8g", "RUSTSEC-2024-0370", "GO-2026-5932" or "PYSEC-2024-1"

name: check_cve

affected.description: Vulnerable product lines from NVD's CPE data: affected from `from`, fixed in `fixed_in` (or last affected `up_to`)

cna_cvss.description: The vendor (CNA) score when it differs from NVD's

osv.description: The OSV.dev advisory, present for an advisory id or a CVE that NVD has not published yet

packages.description: Each affected package and the releases that fix it, one per release line

title: Check a CVE
